verdict: The SC02 is the cheapest box in this index that still does everything the expensive ones do. A 75 L open interior, health monitoring through the app, integrated anti-pinch protection, and — the specification that actually matters to a lot of buyers — a 6.8 inch entrance, the lowest figure any manufacturer here publishes. At $269 that combination is hard to argue with. What you give up is polish and any real track record on materials.
pros: 6.8 in entrance — the lowest published entry height of anything we track
Health monitoring and app control at a budget price
Rated for cats from 3.3 to 22 lb
cons: Meowant publishes no reliable dimensions for the unit
App is basic next to PETKIT or Whisker
Liners are Meowant’s own and we could not confirm third-party bags fit
bestFor: The lowest possible entry price with real features
notIdealFor: Buyers who want a mature app

sections.setup: Meowant publishes no setup time. The unit ships largely assembled and pairs through the Meowant app.
sections.app: Basic but functional: remote control, usage data and health monitoring. It does not approach the depth of the PETKIT or Whisker apps, which at this price is not surprising.
sections.odorControl: Meowant describes an odour removal module. They publish no removal percentage and we have not measured it. The open design limits containment between cycles.
sections.noise: Meowant publishes no decibel figure and we have not measured one, so we are not printing a number.
sections.cleaning: A 75 L open interior with a large entrance, rated for cats from 3.3 to 22 lb. The open-top layout means cats can see out, which lifts acceptance rates.
sections.safety: Meowant describes integrated anti-pinch protection. They publish no sensor count, which is the main gap in an otherwise strong budget specification.
sections.consumables: Meowant liners, sold in 60-packs, plus an optional odour gel refill. We have not sourced current pricing, so we are not publishing a running-cost figure.
sections.longTermCost: At $269 it is among the cheapest powered boxes here. Until we can price the liners we cannot tell you what it costs to keep running.
